offering_description.value: Operates interactive retail stores and a website where children and families choose, stuff and dress plush bears and other toys, sold to individual consumers. It earns from merchandise sales in company-owned stores and online, plus franchise fees and royalties from partner-operated stores.

primary_products.value: plush toys; clothing and accessories for plush toys; gift cards

primary_services.value: in-store bear-making experiences; party and event bookings

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, children, and gift buyers shopping in stores and online

end_markets.value: consumer retail; toys and gifts; children's entertainment

revenue_model.value: product sales: plush toys, outfits and accessories sold in stores and online; licensing or royalties: franchise fees and royalties from partner-operated stores; service fees: fees for in-store bear-making experiences and party bookings
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: sells its branded toys and experiences directly to consumers; brand owner: designs its own bears and accessories, made by outside manufacturers; service provider: runs in-store create-your-own-bear experiences for children and families

geography_served.value: global: company stores in US, Canada, UK, Ireland, franchised stores in Asia, Middle East, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: plush bears and related accessories sold through a single experience-based retail concept

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated retail stores in shopping malls and urban centers; online: company website selling toys, clothing and accessories; partners / resellers: franchise partners operating Build-A-Bear stores in other countries

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: toy safety and children's product rules, such as US CPSIA testing and labeling requirements
